title: 时空幻境
creator: Number None
note: 以时间倒流为核心机制的独立游戏里程碑，Jonathan Blow 用平台跳跃讲了一个关于悔恨的故事。
noteEn: The indie milestone that rewrote time-rewind mechanics, using platforming to tell a story about regret.

title: 超级肉男孩
creator: Team Meat
note: 以像素级精确操作与海量关卡闻名的硬核平台跳跃，开创了本世代 roguelike 平台游戏的先河。
noteEn: A razor-precise hardcore platformer whose tight controls and massive level count redefined indie action.

title: 堡垒
creator: Supergiant Games
note: 旁白叙述随玩家行动实时生成的等距动作 RPG，Supergiant 的第一款作品一鸣惊人。
noteEn: An isometric action-RPG whose narrator reacts to your every move in real time; Supergiant's dazzling debut.

title: 菲斯
creator: Polytron Corporation
note: 通过旋转视角把 2D 世界变成 3D 谜题的像素冒险，纯手工绘制的美术充满谜语。
noteEn: A pixel-art adventure that rotates a 2D world into 3D puzzles, wrapped in handmade visuals and hidden riddles.

title: 洞穴探险
creator: Mossmouth
note: 程序生成洞穴的 roguelike 平台游戏始祖，每个陷阱都能相互联动制造意外死亡。
noteEn: The roguelike platformer that pioneered procedural caves where every trap chains into a glorious death.

title: 风之旅人
creator: thatgamecompany
note: 用无文字的沙漠漫游让陌生玩家彼此合作同行，Austin Wintory 的配乐是点睛之笔。
noteEn: A wordless desert pilgrimage where strangers cooperate wordlessly; Wintory's score is the soul of it.

title: 超越光速
creator: Subset Games
note: 逐房间管理飞船能源与船员的一击毙命 roguelike，每次跃迁都可能终结旅程。
noteEn: Manage a spaceship room-by-room under permadeath pressure; every jump may be your last.

title: 请出示证件
creator: 3909 LLC
note: 扮演边境检查员在无数细则中辨认伪造文件，把道德抉择塞进一张张小卡片里。
noteEn: Play a border inspector flagging forged documents; it turns moral choice into a stack of tiny stamps.

title: 铲子骑士
creator: Yacht Club Games
note: 以 8-bit 风格复刻红白机时代手感的高完成度动作平台游戏，关卡设计堪称教科书。
noteEn: An 8-bit revival that nails NES-era feel; its level design is a masterclass in retro platforming.

title: 晶体管
creator: Supergiant Games
note: 以巨剑里寄存的爱人声音为叙述者，实时与回合制融合的战斗华丽而伤感。
noteEn: A sword that carries a lover's voice narrates; real-time and turn-based combat melt into melancholy beauty.

title: 传说之下
creator: Toby Fox
note: 你可以不杀任何一个怪物通关，弹幕式的战斗与幽默旁白彻底颠覆 RPG 的常规。
noteEn: You can spare every monster; bullet-hell battles and a funny narrator completely subvert RPG convention.

title: 星露谷物语
creator: ConcernedApe
note: 一人开发四年的田园经营经典，种田、采矿、恋爱与小镇节庆层层叠叠地填满生活感。
noteEn: Built by one developer over four years; farming, mining, romance and festivals stack into a lived-in town.

title: 光明旅者
creator: Heart Machine
note: 没有一句对白的 16-bit 动作冒险，节奏凌厉、残影美学，向《暗黑破坏神》致敬的地城战斗。
noteEn: A wordless 16-bit action-adventure with sharp, afterimage-soaked combat that evokes Diablo's dungeons.

title: 奥森弗里
creator: Night School Studio
note: 电台频率扰动时空的超自然青少年群像，对话在行走与打断中自然生长。
noteEn: A supernatural teen story where radio frequencies tear time; dialogue flows through interruption and movement.

title: Inside
creator: Playdead
note: 《地狱边境》团队打造的黑色反乌托邦解谜，压抑氛围在结局达到令人不安的高潮。
noteEn: Playdead's dystopian puzzle-platformer whose suffocating mood crescendos into a haunting final act.

title: 茶杯头
creator: StudioMDHR
note: 逐帧手绘的 1930 年代橡皮管动画风格跑轰游戏，BOSS 战如同会动的老电影。
noteEn: A run-and-gun rendered in hand-drawn 1930s rubber-hose animation; boss fights move like old cartoons.

title: 空洞骑士
creator: Team Cherry
note: 手绘昆虫地下王国的银河城，地图庞大到让人迷路，战斗与探索都极富手感。
noteEn: A hand-drawn insect kingdom Metroidvania so vast it invites getting lost; combat and exploration feel superb.

title: 蔚蓝
creator: Maddy Makes Games
note: 把登山与焦虑症叙事缝合的像素平台跳跃，死亡重试被写成自我接纳的修行。
noteEn: A pixel platformer that welds mountain-climbing to an anxiety story; each retry is a lesson in self-acceptance.

title: 陷阵之志
creator: Subset Games
note: 每回合都能推演敌人行动的小型棋盘策略，把挫败感做成值得反复咀嚼的难题。
noteEn: A compact tactics grid where enemy moves are telegraphed; defeat becomes a puzzle worth chewing on.

title: 奥伯拉·丁的回归
creator: 3909 LLC
note: 用一帧帧死亡瞬间拼凑沉船船员身份的海上悬案，1-bit 美术下是极其精密的推理。
noteEn: Reconstruct a lost ship's crew from frozen death moments; under 1-bit art hides razor-sharp deduction.

title: 格丽斯
creator: Nomada Studio
note: 水彩画般的解谜平台游戏，色彩随主角情绪逐渐苏醒，全程无文字却极富感染力。
noteEn: A watercolor puzzle-platformer where color returns with the heroine's grief; wordless yet deeply moving.

title: 无名之鹅
creator: House House
note: 扮演一只在村庄里到处捣乱的鹅，把「恶作剧清单」玩成行为艺术。
noteEn: Play a mischievous goose terrorizing a village; a checklist of pranks turned into performance art.

title: 星际拓荒
creator: Mobius Digital
note: 太阳系每 22 分钟毁灭一次的宇宙解谜，所有知识都靠玩家亲自探索获得。
noteEn: A solar system that explodes every 22 minutes; every clue is knowledge you earn through exploration.

title: 极乐迪斯科
creator: ZA/UM
note: 侦探的外衣下是彻底的意识形态与自我对话，24 种技能让内心戏成为主要玩法。
noteEn: Beneath a detective premise lies pure ideology and self-talk; 24 skills make your inner monologue the gameplay.

title: 哈迪斯
creator: Supergiant Games
note: 把 roguelike 的死亡循环写成逃离冥界的神话，故事在每次失败中持续推进。
noteEn: A roguelike escape from the underworld where narrative advances with every death; myth made iterative.

title: 邪恶冥刻
creator: Daniel Mullins Games
note: 卡片游戏外皮下藏着层层元叙事的惊悚，每拆开一层都让人脊背发凉。
noteEn: A card game wrapped in nested meta-horror; each layer you peel back chills the spine further.

title: 洞窟物语
creator: Studio Pixel
note: 天谷大辅一人耗时五年免费发布的同人游戏，被视为现代独立游戏的起点之一。
noteEn: Daisuke Amaya's five-year solo freeware that many call the birthplace of the modern indie scene.

title: 迈阿密热线
creator: Dennaton Games
note: 霓虹与电子乐包裹的极速杀戮，一击必死的规则把每一次出击都变成精确规划。
noteEn: Neon-soaked, synth-driven ultraviolence where one-hit deaths turn every sweep into a precise plan.

title: 俄罗斯方块
creator: Alexey Pajitnov
note: 七种方块下落消除的最纯粹形式，几乎在任何硬件上都能完美运行。
noteEn: The purest falling-block puzzle; seven pieces, infinite depth, playable on virtually any machine.

title: 传送门
creator: Valve
note: 用两个传送门改写空间与动量，GLaDOS 的黑色幽默让每个房间都难忘。
noteEn: Two portals rewrite space and momentum; GLaDOS' dark wit makes every chamber memorable.

title: 传送门2
creator: Valve
note: 把凝胶、光束与时光机制全数展开的双人合作解谜，剧本与演出媲美电影。
noteEn: Gels, beams and time mechanics unfold into a co-op puzzle epic with movie-grade writing and staging.

title: 音乐方块
creator: Q Entertainment
note: 方块消除跟随音乐节拍扫过，水口哲也把抽象拼图变成视听一体的冥想。
noteEn: Tetsuya Mizuguchi's puzzle where a beat-line sweeps away blocks, fusing matching with audiovisual trance.

title: 雷顿教授与不可思议的小镇
en: Professor Layton and the Curious Village
creator: Level-5
note: 把上百道脑力题装进优雅的欧式小镇谜案，谜题与叙事相得益彰。
noteEn: Hundreds of brainteasers folded into an elegant European mystery; puzzles and story lift each other.

title: 凯瑟琳
creator: Atlus
note: 推箱子与成人婚恋恐惧的诡异组合，噩梦关卡是真正的硬核考验。
noteEn: Block-pushing welded to adult dread about commitment; the nightmare towers are genuinely brutal.

title: 见证者
creator: Thekla, Inc.
note: 一座岛上千条线谜题，规则从不说明却能被直觉与观察学会。
noteEn: An island of line puzzles whose rules are never told yet learned through observation and epiphany.

title: 斯蒂芬的香肠卷
creator: Increpare Games
note: 只用滚肠与烤炉就构筑出令人绝望的拓扑难题，硬核解谜玩家的圣杯。
noteEn: Just a sausage and a grill yield agonizing topological puzzles; a holy grail for hardcore solvers.

title: 纪念碑谷
creator: ustwo games
note: 以视错觉与埃舍尔式建筑打造的极简几何之旅，每一帧都是壁纸。
noteEn: Escher-esque optical illusions in minimalist geometry; every frame is a wallpaper.

title: 谜室
creator: Fireproof Games
note: 把触屏滑动做成的立体机关盒解谜，手感细腻到每个旋钮都像真实存在。
noteEn: Touch-driven puzzle boxes so tactile every knob feels real; a landmark of mobile puzzle craft.

title: 俄罗斯方块效应
creator: Monstars / Resonair
note: 在经典规则上叠加声光电的沉浸式演出，通关时的通感体验近乎冥想。
noteEn: Classic rules under a synesthetic light-and-sound show; clearing the final stage feels like meditation.

title: 巴巴是你
creator: Hempuli
note: 用词块改写关卡规则本身，把「推箱子」扩展成可编程的逻辑宇宙。
noteEn: Push words that rewrite the rules of the level; it turns Sokoban into a programmable logic universe.

title: 怪物的远征
creator: Draknek & Friends
note: 用漂流的原木搭桥横穿群岛的开放解谜，规则简单到一句话却无穷无尽。
noteEn: Rafting across an archipelago with floating logs; one-sentence rules spiral into endless puzzles.

title: 噗哟噗哟俄罗斯方块
creator: Sega
note: 两种国民级消除规则的梦幻联动，跨规则对战让节奏与策略激烈碰撞。
noteEn: Two national puzzle rules collide in cross-mode battles where timing and strategy clash.

title: 杰出之作
creator: Zachtronics
note: 用机械臂搭建炼金流水线，解法没有唯一答案，只有更优雅的答案。
noteEn: Build alchemy assembly lines with robotic arms; there is no right answer, only more elegant ones.

title: 太空化学
creator: Zachtronics
note: 编写化学工厂的反应管线，是 Zachtronics 编程解谜传统的开山之作。
noteEn: Program reaction pipelines in a chemistry factory; the template for Zachtronics' coding-puzzle lineage.

title: 人力资源机器
creator: Tomorrow Corporation
note: 把汇编语言包装成办公室小职员的任务，编程概念在欢笑中自然习得。
noteEn: Assembly programming disguised as office busywork; coding concepts sneak in through giggles.

title: 粘粘世界
creator: 2D Boy
note: 黏黏小球搭桥的解谜小品，物理互动与荒诞叙事开创了 Wii 平台独立游戏时代。
noteEn: Gloopy goo-balls and physics bridges with absurdist wit; it opened Wii to the indie scene.

title: 寂静岭2
creator: Team Silent
note: 把恐怖的重心从怪物转向内心的愧疚，雾镇里的每个怪物都是心魔的投影。
noteEn: Horror turned inward: the fog town's creatures are projections of guilt, not just monsters.

title: 生化危机4
creator: Capcom
note: 越肩视角与体术掀翻三上真司自己缔造的固定机位传统，是第三人称射击的分水岭。
noteEn: Over-the-shoulder aiming and melee broke the fixed-camera tradition; the watershed of third-person shooters.

title: 死亡空间
creator: Visceral Games
note: 把肢解异形当作战斗核心的太空船恐怖，UI 全部融入世界观没有一处跳出。
noteEn: Space-horror where dismemberment is the core strategy; the UI lives entirely inside the diegetic world.

title: 失忆症：黑暗后裔
creator: Frictional Games
note: 没有武器、只能逃跑与躲藏的第一人称恐怖，奠定了「逃生恐怖」的模板。
noteEn: First-person terror with no weapons, only hiding; it codified the run-and-hide survival horror template.

title: 心灵杀手
creator: Remedy Entertainment
note: 以手电筒驱散黑暗的湖畔小镇惊悚，把创作焦虑与电视剧式分集叙事结合。
noteEn: Flashlight-lit dread in a lakeside town, fusing creative anxiety with TV-style episodic pacing.

title: 恶灵附身
creator: Tango Gameworks
note: 三上真司回归生存恐怖的执念之作，场景在精神世界与现实间反复扭曲。
noteEn: Shinji Mikami's return to survival horror; reality warps between mind and matter without mercy.

title: 异形：隔离
creator: Creative Assembly
note: 异形由 AI 驱动、无法预判行踪，把一个猎手放进永远不能放松的太空站。
noteEn: An AI-driven Xenomorph that learns and hunts you across a space station; you can never relax.

title: PT
creator: Kojima Productions
note: 可玩预告片用一段循环走廊颠覆了整代恐怖游戏，可惜最终随项目取消而绝版。
noteEn: A playable teaser that reinvented horror in one looping corridor, delisted forever with Silent Hills.

title: 直到黎明
creator: Supermassive Games
note: 把好莱坞恐怖片变成可玩交互，蝴蝶效应让每个角色的生死都由你的选择决定。
noteEn: A playable slasher movie where butterfly-effect choices decide who survives the cabin night.

title: 血源诅咒
creator: FromSoftware
note: 哥特克苏鲁风格的魂系动作，主动进攻的回血系统把战斗逼到疯狂边缘。
noteEn: Gothic Lovecraftian Souls-action; rallying by aggression pushes combat to a fever pitch.

title: 活体脑细胞
creator: Frictional Games
note: 深海基地里拷问意识与复制体的科幻恐怖，惊吓背后是令人失眠的哲学。
noteEn: Sci-fi dread in an underwater base probing consciousness; the horror lingers as sleepless philosophy.

title: 生化危机7
creator: Capcom
note: 第一人称视角回归密室恐怖，贝克一家的美国南方邪典味浓到化不开。
noteEn: First-person survival returns to cramped dread; the Baker family drips Southern Gothic menace.

title: 小小梦魇
creator: Tarsier Studios
note: 黄雨衣小人穿过巨型怪物的邮轮，尺寸反差把恐惧做成精致的黑暗童话。
noteEn: A child in a yellow raincoat crawls through a giant's ship; scale becomes a delicate dark fairy tale.

title: 生化危机2 重制版
creator: Capcom
note: 以现代引擎重建浣熊市的暴君追逐，恐怖与弹药管理的紧张感精准复刻。
noteEn: Raccoon City rebuilt in a modern engine; Mr. X's pursuit keeps tension and ammo scarcity razor-sharp.

title: 逃生
creator: Red Barrels
note: 全程只能靠夜视摄影机逃亡的精神病院之旅，电量与恐惧同步耗尽。
noteEn: Flee a mental asylum with only a night-vision camcorder; batteries and nerve drain together.

title: 啪啦啪啦啪
creator: NanaOn-Sha
note: 把说唱节奏对战做成整个玩法，松浦雅也以纸片动画定义了节奏游戏。
noteEn: Rap-battle timing as pure gameplay; paper-cutout animation that defined the rhythm genre.

title: 热舞革命
creator: Konami
note: 街机脚垫踩出节拍的国民级音游，把游戏厅变成舞池。
noteEn: The arcade dance pad that turned game rooms into dance floors; a national rhythm institution.

title: 吉他英雄
creator: Harmonix
note: 五键塑料吉他让普通人体验摇滚主唱的幻觉，直接引爆了音乐游戏热潮。
noteEn: A five-button plastic guitar gives everyone a rock-star fantasy; it ignited the rhythm-game boom.

title: 精英节拍特工
creator: iNiS
note: 用触屏点按跟上旋律的特工小队，把真人照片故事演成荒诞又热血的音乐剧。
noteEn: Touch-screen agents dance to the beat through photo-real stories; a bizarrely heartfelt rhythm musical.

title: 摇滚乐队
creator: Harmonix
note: 四人齐奏吉他、贝斯、鼓与麦克风的合奏体验，把客厅变成家庭乐队现场。
noteEn: Four-player guitar, bass, drums and vocals turned living rooms into a full family band.

title: 节奏地牢
creator: Brace Yourself Games
note: 把 roguelike 行动锁定到节拍上的天才融合，打拍子即走位、即杀敌。
noteEn: Roguelike movement locked to a beat; every step and strike must land on the downbeat.

title: 重击者
creator: Drool
note: 以金属节拍撞击轨道的高速恐怖音游，狂暴视听把玩家推向节奏深渊。
noteEn: A violent rhythm racer slamming a beetle through hyperspeed tunnels; it weaponizes the beat.

title: 节奏光剑
creator: Beat Games
note: 用 VR 光剑切开迎面而来的音符，把健身与音游合二为一的杀手级作品。
noteEn: Slice incoming beats with VR sabers; the killer app that fused fitness with rhythm games.

title: 再见狂野之心
creator: Simogo
note: 流媒体流行乐的梦幻跑酷，霓虹、心碎与骑行在 90 分钟里一气呵成。
noteEn: A dream-pop on-rails arcade ride; neon, heartbreak and motorcycles in one euphoric 90 minutes.

title: 舞力全开
creator: Ubisoft
note: 用体感识别跟着热门单曲起舞，派对与家庭聚会的万能暖场神器。
noteEn: Motion-tracking dance to chart hits; the surest way to warm up any party or family gathering.

title: 初音未来：歌姬计划
creator: Sega
note: 让虚拟歌姬在精致 PV 中登台演唱的按键音游，把 Vocaloid 文化带向大众。
noteEn: Tap to the beat as virtual idol Miku performs in gorgeous PVs; it carried Vocaloid culture mainstream.

title: 逆转裁判
creator: Capcom
note: 以「异议！」翻盘庭审的法庭推理，把调查、举证与嘴炮做成教科书式视觉小说。
noteEn: Courtroom deduction built on 'Objection!' turns; investigation and cross-examination as VN canon.

title: CLANNAD
creator: Key
note: Key 社催泪三作的代表，小镇、家庭与光玉的叙事足以让人哭到透支。
noteEn: Key's tearjerker masterpiece; a town, a family and orbs of light that leave you emotionally spent.

title: 命运之夜
creator: Type-Moon
note: 圣杯战争与英灵召唤的宏大设定，直接催生了横跨十余年的超级 IP。
noteEn: The Holy Grail War saga whose worldbuilding spawned a multi-decade multimedia empire.

title: 428：被封锁的涩谷
creator: Chunsoft
note: 用真人影像推进 5 条并行故事线，实时连锁的抉择让涩谷一夜层层失控。
noteEn: Live-action vignettes across five interlocking timelines; one night in Shibuya spirals out of control.

title: 命运石之门
creator: 5pb.
note: 微波炉改造成时光机的时间旅行叙事，从日常喜剧到绝望螺旋的转换教科书。
noteEn: A microwave time machine and the cost of every 'D-Mail'; the canonical descent from comedy to despair.

title: 极限脱出 9小时9人9之门
en: Nine Hours, Nine Persons, Nine Doors
creator: Spike Chunsoft
note: 密室逃脱谜题与多重结局交织的数字根谜团，第九人身份的反转令人拍案。
noteEn: Escape-the-room puzzles wired into a digital-root conspiracy; the ninth-person twist stuns.

title: 极限脱出 善人死亡
creator: Spike Chunsoft
note: 把囚徒困境搬进密室逃脱，剧情树分支庞大到需要用流程图来导航。
noteEn: Prisoner's dilemma inside escape rooms; its branching story tree is so wide it needs a flowchart.

title: 弹丸论破：希望的学园与绝望高中生
creator: Spike Chunsoft
note: 黑白熊的互相残杀学级裁判，把日常推理、法庭辩论与「论破」炫技结合。
noteEn: Monokuma's killing game: slice-of-life, courtroom debate and 'breaking' contradictions in one trial.

title: 海市蜃楼之馆
creator: Novectacle
note: 被诅咒之馆横跨千年的悲剧群像，哥特式的爱与赎罪让人久久无法出戏。
noteEn: A cursed mansion's thousand-year tragedy; Gothic love and atonement that stays with you long after.

title: 赛博朋克酒保行动
creator: Sukeban Games
note: 在霓虹酒馆调酒听客人倾诉的赛博朋克日常，调酒配方本身就是故事线索。
noteEn: Mix drinks and listen to a neon city's regulars; every cocktail recipe doubles as story.

title: 心跳文学部
creator: Team Salvato
note: 披着恋爱喜剧外衣的元恐怖，越界修改文件的那一刻起就再也回不了头。
noteEn: A dating-sim shell hiding meta-horror; once it starts editing its own files, you cannot unsee it.

title: 双人成行
creator: Hazelight Studios
note: 强制双人合作的动作冒险，每章都在变新玩法，把离婚夫妇写进一场奇想。
noteEn: Co-op-only adventure that reinvents its mechanics every level, telling a divorce story through whimsy.

title: 胡闹厨房2
creator: Ghost Town Games
note: 在会移动的厨房里分工烹饪，是检验友情与默契的终极压力测试。
noteEn: Coordinate a kitchen on moving platforms; the ultimate stress test for friendships.

title: 保持通话，没人爆炸
creator: Steel Crate Games
note: 一人拆弹、同伴翻手册指路的 VR 经典，把沟通失误变成最欢乐的爆炸现场。
noteEn: One player defuses, friends read the manual; miscommunication becomes the funniest blast.

title: 杰克盒派对合集3
creator: Jackbox Games
note: 手机当手柄的答题派对合集，《Quiplash》让损友金句成为全场笑点。
noteEn: A phone-as-controller quiz party; Quiplash turns your friends' dumbest answers into the show.

title: 群殴野兽
creator: Boneloaf
note: 软体布偶互殴的物理格斗派对，僵硬到极致的打斗反而笑料百出。
noteEn: Gelatinous brawlers fight with hilariously floppy physics; every punch is a pratfall.

title: 马力欧派对 超级巨星
creator: NDcube
note: 复刻 N64 时代经典地图与小游戏，一掷骰子就让友谊翻脸如翻书。
noteEn: Classic N64 boards and minigames remastered; one dice roll is all it takes to end friendships.

title: 马力欧卡丁车8 豪华版
creator: Nintendo
note: 蓝龟壳与道具乱斗的国民赛车，把竞速变成人人能赢的派对狂欢。
noteEn: Item-fueled chaos on the track; the blue shell keeps every racer one spin away from losing.

title: 街头霸王2
en: Street Fighter II: The World Warrior
creator: Capcom
note: 定义了现代格斗游戏的八人可选阵容与必杀技输入，街机厅的一代神话。
noteEn: Eight selectable fighters and special-move inputs defined modern fighting games; an arcade legend.

title: 铁拳3
creator: Namco
note: 把 3D 格斗的动作流畅度提升到新高度，被视为 PS1 上最完美的格斗游戏。
noteEn: 3D fighting rendered with unprecedented fluidity; often called the PS1's finest fighter.

title: 任天堂明星大乱斗DX
creator: HAL Laboratory
note: 把击飞百分比做成竞技深度的平台格斗，二十年后的职业赛场上依然活跃。
noteEn: Platform fighting where knockback percent breeds depth; still thriving on pro circuits decades later.

title: 任天堂明星大乱斗 特别版
creator: Bandai Namco Studios
note: 收录历代全部角色的「全明星」阵容，是任天堂跨世代 IP 的终极庆典。
noteEn: Every fighter in series history returns; the ultimate crossover celebration of Nintendo's IP.

title: 铁拳7
creator: Bandai Namco Studios
note: 用虚幻引擎表现 3D 格斗的帧级手感，三岛家族恩怨在最终章落幕。
noteEn: Unreal Engine polish on frame-perfect 3D combat; the Mishima saga reaches its final showdown.

title: 真人快打11
creator: NetherRealm Studios
note: 以极致血腥终结技闻名的格斗系列，故事模式拍得像院线动作片。
noteEn: Notorious for its gory fatalities; the story mode alone plays like a blockbuster action film.

title: 罪恶装备 奋战
creator: Arc System Works
note: 2D 手绘动画渲染到极致的格斗，华丽连段与重金属摇滚相得益彰。
noteEn: Hand-drawn anime fighters at peak fidelity; flashy combos meet a heavy-metal heart.

title: 街头霸王6
creator: Capcom
note: 以「现代模式」降低入门门槛并保留深度，时隔多年让街霸回到主流视野。
noteEn: A 'Modern' control scheme lowers the bar without losing depth, reviving the franchise's mainstream pull.

title: Wii 运动
creator: Nintendo
note: 用体感挥动 Wii 遥控器的全家同乐套装，是史上最畅销的电子游戏之一。
noteEn: Motion-controlled tennis, bowling and more; one of the best-selling video games of all time.

title: 实况足球9
creator: Konami
note: 实况系列公认的巅峰作，球员 AI 与传控手感至今仍被玩家怀念。
noteEn: The consensus peak of the Winning Eleven series; its passing and AI still feel years ahead.

title: FIFA 14
creator: EA Canada
note: 首次引入「纯正射门」与物理引擎的 FIFA，是把足球模拟带上新台阶的一作。
noteEn: Introduced pure shot physics to the franchise; a milestone in making virtual football feel real.

title: 火箭联盟
creator: Psyonix
note: 把足球与喷气赛车拼在一起的奇想，物理掌握到极致后就是电子竞技天花板。
noteEn: Soccer with rocket cars; mastered physics turn it into one of esports' most skill-expressive titles.

title: NBA 嘉年华
creator: Midway
note: 二对二的街机篮球，夸张灌篮与「他着火了！」的解说成就了街机厅的疯狂。
noteEn: 2v2 arcade basketball with booming dunks and 'He's on fire!'; pure arcade mayhem.

title: 托尼·霍克职业滑板2
creator: Neversoft
note: 加入抓板与手动组合的滑板游戏巅峰，连招系统至今仍是同类标杆。
noteEn: The skateboarding summit with reverts and manuals; its combo system remains the genre benchmark.

title: SSX 极限滑雪
creator: EA Canada
note: 把滑雪玩成花式特技的极限运动，快节奏与夸张动作定义了街头文化的爽快。
noteEn: Snowboarding as high-flying stunt spectacle; speed and audacity define its arcade soul.
